Package view.components

Class DisplayCanvas

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Canvas
view.components.DisplayCanvas
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, CursoredCanvas
public class DisplayCanvas extends Canvas implements CursoredCanvas
The canvas upon which to draw theorems. The canvas is particularly 'view part of the application' but it also encapsulates and shields a core part of the model, namely the which is created in it and should be accessed through either this which lays out and draws the theorem or via the which stores all canvases.

  • Constructor Details

    • DisplayCanvas

      public DisplayCanvas(DTheorem theorem)
      Instantiates a new canvas for drawing a fantastic math theorem upon. The canvas determines how the theorem's description is laid out. Every canvas holds one and only one theorem and is the only direct holder of that theorem.
      Parameters:
      theorem - The theorem that is described by this canvas.

    • setWritecursor

      public void setWritecursor(DCursor movedto)
      Sets the cursor's position, this canvas's write point to the given cursor's write point.
      Parameters:
      movedto - The described formal who's reference point should be the new write point. If this is null the writepoint is set to the startcursors.

    • setWritecursor

      public void setWritecursor(DCursor movedto, Point2D.Double origo, Point2D.Double offset)
      Sets the cursor's position, this canvas's write point.
      Parameters:
      movedto - If there is no offset (offset is null) the writepoint is set to this described formals local reference point.
      origo - The position in the canvas where the current cursor has it's upper left corner.
      offset - The offset, the cursors reference point, from the local origo.
